runtimeNotes: GSI国土地理院DEM5A(航空激光5m)与缺值处DEM10B(等高线10m)混合高程，321×321地理重采样；实际输出约7.3×4.7m，非完整5m测绘。保持米制，不放大高差。路面、看台基础、立交和2026临时设施仍需独立结构资料。

runtimeSource.notes: Processed GSI elevation tiles: DEM5A laser5m at zoom15; only missing cells use DEM10B contour10m at zoom14. Signed RGB elevation encoding in0.01m. Bilinear Web-Mercator pixel-centre/geographic resampling, no vertical scaling or visibility-fitted heights. Not a2026 circuit/stand engineering survey. Native/source fallback masks retained.

limitations: Source5m where present;10m contour fallback in missing cells, not uniform5m precision. Output spacing about7.3m east-west and4.7m north-south. Official PNG timestamps are distribution dates, not2026 survey dates. Bridges, terrace floors and stand foundations are not certified. The 2025 legacy TXT sample differs from updated2026 PNG by0.02-0.05m; current GSI listing states TXT updates stopped in2024. No offset fitted to the legacy text or to visibility is applied.
